text:
Alex: Quick async check — can we list current owners and blockers for the v2 compatibility rollout? Main things we need: SDK owners (JS/Python), infra changes (routing/canary), docs/runbook, and a canary window. Targeting cutover week of May 12.

Mika: I own JS/TS SDK. Blocker: #4123 (lint + node version pin). CI failing on Windows job. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-js/pull/4123. ETA to fix tomorrow EOD.

Jamal: Infra owner here. Need INF-789 for canary nodes + routing rule. Also need capacity carve for Dedicated pool during canary (estimate 4x normal). Opened ticket and tagged infra-costs. I can schedule the canary cluster but need a signed-off change window.

Elaine: I'll take docs + migration guide. Plan: short "what to change" + migration snippet + deprecation banner copy. Will put draft in docs PR by Wed. Need final owner for embedding endpoints example.

Karim: I can run the canary / monitor rollout. Will require feature flag keys and a toggle in rollout service. Proposed flag: `v2_compat_canary` with cohorts: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%.

Mika: noted re cohorts. Also need SDK bump in package and a compatibility shim: `client.setCompatMode(true)`. We should document fallback behavior.

Karim: config snippet for rollout service: ```json
{
  "flag": "v2_compat_canary",
  "stages": ["1%","5%","20%","100%"],
  "metrics": ["latency_p50","token_error_rate"]
}
```

Alex: @Mika @Jamal @Elaine @Karim — who owns SDK Python?

Mika: Python SDK is backlogged, tagging @Elaine to confirm product priority or @Alex if we should hire temp help. I can do a small compatibility shim but not full test coverage before the canary.

Elaine: I can reprioritize Python SDK basic shim (happy path only) — ETA one sprint. Will add acceptance criteria to docs PR.

devex-bot: SDK CI status — `sdk-js` build succeeded, `sdk-py` failing (missing wheel).

Jamal: Infra blocker detail: routing rule change requires ACL update for the model router; security review queued (SEC-321). That may add 48 hours. If security review blocks, we should shift first canary by one business day.

Alex: OK re SEC-321. For schedule planning: propose owners matrix and milestone list — canary ready (code + infra + docs) by May 8, canary start May 12, full cutover May 16. Does that timeline work?

Mika: May 8 is tight for JS lint fix + tests, but doable if CI green by Tue.

Elaine: Docs PR by Wed aligns. Will draft deprecation banner copy now: "Heads up: v1 endpoints will be deprecated on June 1. Migrate to v2 using the guide."

Karim: I'll prepare monitoring dashboard and alert playbook. Need exact metric names, suggest we watch `v2_request_latency`, `v2_token_errors`, and `v2_kvcache_hit`.

sre-bot: Scheduled maintenance window reserved: May 12 03:00-06:00 UTC for canary (pending infra ticket close).

Alex: Action items: (1) Mika fix #4123 CI (owner Mika), (2) Jamal unblock INF-789 + SEC-321 (owner Jamal), (3) Elaine publish docs + deprecation copy (owner Elaine), (4) Karim prepare flag + dashboard (owner Karim). I'll update the owners matrix and create umbrella ticket RED-2100 to track.

Mika: ping me in thread when infra is unblocked, I'll queue SDK release.

Jamal: I'll post updates on INF-789 and SEC-321 here.

Elaine: I'll open the docs PR and put reviewers: @Mika, @Karim.

Alex: Thanks all. If any unexpected blocker pops up, drop a short note here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
